brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) with top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top) and 6 solid end caps on all side bearings (caps at 30/90/150/210/270/330) forming a sealed box. check_build ok, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre (port:0#0,0#0, stem hex-port-louvre) fitted to the enclosure wall; designed to vent without letting rain in.
Enclosure interior is the full hex cell (~166x144mm top area, 80mm height) providing volume for a board; enclosure is closed so board is housed inside (not visible from outside, as expected).

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell enclosure from a full hex base, capped on all six sides and with a solid top cover, with a hex-port-louvre installed for ventilation. Interior provides breathing room for the electronics board.
